### Accessibility and behavior

- Native labelled controls expose focus and invalid-edit feedback; successful edits emit a typed viz.render input fragment.

Role: `textbox`.

Accessible name: `label` strategy targeting `input[name="x.field"]`.

| Keyboard input | Declared outcome |
| --- | --- |
| `Tab` | Focus the labelled chart input |
| `x` | Edit the declared field name |

### Compatibility

Area chart: controls the public Cartesian viz.render fragment, not the legacy HTML placeholder's unimplemented styling fields. The consumer supplies rows and calls the renderer. Opacity uses six bounded presets; fields/colors/scale/chart type preserve sibling input bindings. No consumer action is executed by this component.
